text: {"score":3,"justification":"The core numbers match the card: 14.0% share, 3.1% expected, 7.31 risk-adjusted score, z of 1.56, 1,287 claims, 44 documented, 19 documented 99215, and 31% low-complexity. The cautious 'inconclusive' framing is appropriate. But several claims are unsupported, misread or inconsistent, so an investigator would need to redo some checking.","problems":["'Above the all-provider rate in every complexity band' is true on the card, but the 0-condition share (0.06) is far below the 0.264 and 0.64 shares in higher bands, and the summary does not give these per-band numbers.","The 'problems 23%' figure and the late, unsigned and data percentages are not on the card. The script could not match 23, and the author's tool output is not shown here to ground it.","'Against 4% for comparison providers' appears to come from the card's all_provider_rate of 0.045 for 99215, but that is the below-billed rate, which is plausible but loosely stated.","C0065496 is described as a single-condition 99215 appearing among problem-flagged notes, but the card shows no note-flag data per claim, so this cannot be verified. Likewise 'repeated time entries' is not supported by the card.","The summary says 0-condition visits were coded 'only for rash, abdominal pain or URI', but the cited 0-condition claims have dx R21 (rash), R10.9, J06.9. This fits, yet C0065958 is R21 only and C0065850 is also R21, so the 'abdominal pain/URI' examples are not matched to the claims actually named.","The fixed-format examples (C0064593, C0064701) are 1-condition visits, not the 0-condition visits the narrative emphasizes, and C0064593 and C0064701 both carry N39.0, which is unmentioned. The next step also names those two claims rather than the 0-condition ones, so it is inconsistent with the text's advice.","The headline says 'small set of returned charts all support the billed level', but the card shows only 19 documented 99215 claims, and the 'support' finding rests on MDM and minutes for just 4 examples, one with no minutes recorded."]}
